# Pull Request

## Description

Brief description of changes made in this PR.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring (no functional changes)
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Test improvement

## Testing

- [ ] All existing tests pass (`npm test`)
- [ ] New tests added for changes (if applicable)
- [ ] Manual testing completed
- [ ] TypeScript compilation successful (`npm run typecheck`)
- [ ] All build variants successful (`npm run build:all`)

## Changes Made

### Added

- List any new features or functionality

### Changed

- List any changes to existing functionality

### Fixed

- List any bug fixes

### Removed

- List any removed features or functionality

## Breaking Changes

If this PR introduces breaking changes, please describe them and provide migration instructions:

```typescript
// Before
oldFunction();

// After
newFunction();
```

## Documentation

- [ ] Documentation updated (README.md, API reference, etc.)
- [ ] Examples updated (if applicable)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated

## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows project style guidelines
- [ ] Self-review completed
- [ ] Code is well-commented
- [ ] Tests added/updated for changes
- [ ] All tests pass
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] No breaking changes (or clearly documented)
- [ ] Performance impact considered

## Related Issues

Closes #(issue_number)

Any additional information that reviewers should know.
